title: BringBackSquilly
description: Brings back the Squilly respawn mechanic/glitch in 1.21+.
body:
# BringBackSquilly

This plugin returns the Squilly respawn mechanic/glitch to 1.21+. This is useful if you want a newer-version prison.

The quirkier aspects of the mechanic are also preserved. If you place a slab on your respawn point, your Y coordinate when you respawn will also be offset by 0.5.

## Squilly Mechanic Usage

Place a boat or shulker blocking your respawn point. You'll then respawn on top of the pillar.

Also see [Squilly's original video on the mechanic](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IqrQ9Xess0k).

## Plugin Installation

Simply put the jar file in your plugins folder and restart your server. It will start working immediately with no setup or config needed!

## Support

To get support, report bugs, or make feature requests, please go to the [issues page](https://github.com/greatericontop/BringBackSquilly/issues).
